title: skill-creator evaluation: multi-run benchmark with variance and description optimization
description: User priority #1 (2026-09-26, after TS-13): run the skill-creator process on the six skills. Benchmark 5 cases (4 existing + TypeScript audit), with and without skills, 3 runs each; grade with skill-creator's grader plus the objective graders; aggregate with aggregate_benchmark and produce the eval viewer. Then run run_loop description optimization per skill (60/40 train/test holdout, 3 runs/query) in a stub project root, with proof-skills' run_eval keep-scanning patch. The user runs claude plugin eval (#2) afterwards.

acceptanceCriteria.text: benchmark.json and benchmark.md produced by aggregate_benchmark for 5 cases x 2 configs x 3 runs, with mean and stddev
Static eval viewer generated with generate_review.py for the user to review
run_loop run for all six skills; best descriptions applied only where held-out test score is not worse, with before/after scores recorded
